reading.zh: 候选池的两级闸门：selector.shortlist 先按评分生成短名单，pruner.prune 再裁剪到前 K。两级都执行**同一套豁免规则**——生存骨架（eat/drink/rest/forage）无条件保送，found/socialize/court/accept 各占独立席位。纯按分数截断会让基础分低的刚需行动被挤出窗口：实测新增 found 后窗口变成 [craft,build,expedition,write,found,drink]，eat/forage 缺席，全镇不再采集，食水归零后永不恢复，三种子里两个全灭。
reading.en: Two gates over the candidate pool: selector.shortlist builds the shortlist by score, then pruner.prune trims to top-K. Both apply the SAME exemptions: the survival spine is always reserved and found/socialize/court/accept hold dedicated seats. Pure score truncation evicts low-base-score necessities; measured, adding found turned the window into [craft,build,expedition,write,found,drink] with eat/forage absent, the settlement stopped foraging, supplies hit zero and never recovered.
